$comment: The field controls a step type definition can use: the Step Type Builder's palette. Each control lists the field properties it reads and the features an author can switch off. A composite's `defaults` seed a new step that places it: `blankCondition` adds one blank condition and `params` fills blank parameters. A definition's field names one control in `control`. js/step-types/02-definitions.js checks fields against this file (validate with `palette`), and ATLAS renders only controls whose status is `available` in the engine it runs. Feature defaults are `true`; a definition switches one off with `features: { name: false }`, which hides it for new steps only. Only features marked `switchable` can be named there; a feature marked `planned` is not built yet, so it is off in every engine. Properties marked `internal` (commonProperties) or listed in a control's `internalProperties`, and a definition's `editorFrame` (its class, heading and tabs), exist only to keep the markup of editors that came with ATLAS Align; the builder never offers them.

commonProperties.name: param
commonProperties.description: The step parameter the control reads and writes. Never renamed once steps use it.

commonProperties.name: help
commonProperties.description: Hint shown under the control and linked to it with aria-describedby.

commonProperties.name: helpId
commonProperties.description: Id of the help text, for markup that names it. Defaults to atlas-<param>-hint.

commonProperties.name: required
commonProperties.description: Marks the control required and reports a blank value as an Audit Issue.

commonProperties.name: requiredIssue
commonProperties.description: false keeps the required mark but leaves the Audit Issue to the type's own checks.

commonProperties.name: default
commonProperties.description: Value written to a new or blank step.

commonProperties.name: visibleWhen
commonProperties.description: Shows the control only when the condition holds. The editor redraws when a parameter the condition reads changes.

commonProperties.name: enabledWhen
commonProperties.description: Disables the control unless the condition holds.

commonProperties.name: layout
commonProperties.description: full spans the whole editor row. pair puts shown fields that are next to each other in one row, as two pickers side by side.

commonProperties.name: group
commonProperties.description: Groups related fields in the builder.

commonProperties.name: tab
commonProperties.description: Internal, never offered by the builder. The editorFrame tab that shows the field. Kept for IF / THEN, whose editor shows the conditions and the action on two tabs.

commonProperties.name: sharesParam
commonProperties.description: Internal, never offered by the builder. Lets a second field show a param another field already shows, in another mode. Kept for Create Column, whose editor shows column_name, expression and column_description in two forms each.

controls.name: source_picker
controls.label: Source picker
controls.description: Chooses one of the audit's source files.

controls.name: field_picker
controls.label: Field picker
controls.description: Chooses a field of a source, or any field and created column when no source is linked.

controls.name: choice
controls.label: Choice
controls.description: One value from a fixed list, as cards, chips, a segmented control or a select. Each option can be hidden for new steps; a saved step that uses a hidden option still shows it. optionsFrom names a catalog list (such as app_config.logic_options.create_value_modes) that decides which values are offered and in what order; options with the same value give their label and description.

controls.name: text
controls.label: Text
controls.description: One line of text, with optional suggestions.

controls.name: textarea
controls.label: Long text
controls.description: Several lines of text.

controls.name: whole_number
controls.label: Whole number
controls.description: A whole number between optional limits.

controls.name: toggle
controls.label: Toggle
controls.description: Yes or No.

controls.name: hidden
controls.label: Hidden value
controls.description: Keeps a parameter on the step without showing it.

controls.name: hint
controls.label: Hint
controls.description: A line of help text. Writes no parameter; param only names it.

controls.name: callout
controls.label: Callout
controls.description: A highlighted note built from a template, usually shown with visibleWhen. Writes no parameter; param only names it.

controls.name: readout
controls.label: Read-only value
controls.description: Shows a fixed setting as read-only text, built from a template `message`. Writes no parameter; param only names it.

controls.name: block
controls.label: Editor block
controls.description: An editor named from the step type library (sort_keys, duplicate_keys). Kept for definitions written before these became controls.

controls.name: sort_keys
controls.label: Sort fields
controls.description: A list of sort fields, each with a direction. Stores sort_fields_json and mirrors the first field to source_file, field_name and sort_direction.

controls.name: duplicate_keys
controls.label: Duplicate key fields
controls.description: A list of fields that together identify a duplicate. Stores duplicate_fields_json and mirrors the first field to source_file and field_name.

controls.name: condition_group
controls.label: Conditions
controls.description: IF conditions joined with AND / OR, with nested groups. Stores the tree in conditions_json and keeps the step's conditions list in step with it; a step without conditions gets one blank condition. Drawn by the app's own editor for now, so the builder cannot change its parts; it can switch off nested groups.

features.name: nesting
features.label: Nested groups
features.description: AND / OR groups inside the condition list. Off drops the Sub-condition button; a saved step's groups still show.

features.name: fieldCompare
features.label: Compare with a field
features.description: Compare with another field, including one from a second source.

features.name: valueList
features.label: Value lists
features.description: Compare with several values at once.

features.name: runParameters
features.label: Run parameters
features.description: Compare with a run parameter such as the run date.

features.name: firstAvailable
features.label: First available value
features.description: Use the first field that has a value.

features.name: groupChecks
features.label: Group checks
features.description: Checks across the records of a group.

controls.name: action
controls.label: Action
controls.description: What a THEN or ELSE branch does: display or leave out the records, write text, a field, a calculation or part of a text value into a column, or describe the action in words. Stores then_action_type and the parameters of the chosen action, and gives the outcome qTest tests. Drawn by the app's own editor for now, so the builder cannot change its parts; it can switch off freeform text.

features.name: display_text
features.label: Display text
features.description: Write a text response in a column.

features.name: set_column_value
features.label: Set value from a field
features.description: Copy a field into a column.

features.name: set_column_calculation
features.label: Calculation
features.description: Write a calculation into a column.

features.name: set_column_string_transform
features.label: String transformation
features.description: Write part of a text value into a column.

features.name: freeform
features.label: Freeform text
features.description: Describe the action in words. Off drops the Freeform Text choice; a saved freeform step still shows it.

controls.name: math
controls.label: Calculation
controls.description: A source field with math operations and rounding. Stores the operations as JSON in source_math_json. Drawn by the app's own editor for now, so the builder cannot change its parts.

controls.name: string_transform
controls.label: String transformation
controls.description: Part of a text value: first or last characters, character count, or a split into columns named string_split_column_1, string_split_column_2... Drawn by the app's own editor for now, so the builder cannot change its parts.

controls.name: join_type
controls.label: Join type
controls.description: The join type (INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL OUTER or UNION) with a Choose Join Type button that opens the join type picker. Stores join_type. Drawn by the app's own editor for now, so the builder cannot change its parts.

controls.name: join_keys
controls.label: Join keys
controls.description: Pairs of fields that match records of two sources. Stores join_keys_json, mirrors the first pair to left_field and right_field, and keeps left_source and right_source. Drawn by the app's own editor for now, so the builder cannot change its parts or switch off its features.

features.name: multipleKeys
features.label: Several key pairs
features.description: Match on more than one pair of fields.
